required.rationale: current_state destroy-failed of that subject (parsec's own vocabulary: babylon.py:1061). Only the Babylon result carries it; the decoy and the other subject are 'started'

counts.asked_by: how much did that service cost
counts.rationale: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud - Compute's window cost, the largest item of the account's row. It carries 'which service accounts for most of it' too: there is no bare service-name fact, because EC2 is a guess any model makes for an AWS account (the 073 lesson). 1,148 occurs only as that item's cost
